subject: Unforeseen mechanical field condition: undersized mechanical shaft in the corridor chase

messages.text: Our crew hit the undersized mechanical shaft in the corridor chase at T-1 and need your call on the permanent fix. This needs immediate attention; please respond as soon as possible. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. This is holding up work in this area. A response Friday would be appreciated.
Reroute to clear the conflict at T-1 per the attached sketch; proceed once you've confirmed clearance. There will be a cost impact to address this condition.
Photos show the undersized mechanical shaft in the corridor chase at T-1 goes further than we first thought -- does your direction still cover it? A response Friday would be appreciated.
